about: Raderna i "Blades was updated"-popupen: en post per EAS Update, nyast först, id +1 varje gång. Bara den uppdateringens egna ändringar, på engelska, med New:, Improved: eller Fixed: som App Store-texten och det viktigaste först. Se services/updateNotes.ts och scripts/publish-update.mjs.

notes: Fixed: FAA requirements in Next licence now follow Part 61, with separate ATP requirements for helicopters.
Improved: FAA cross-country time counts flights that land more than 50 NM away, or 25 NM in a helicopter.
Improved: FAA instrument currency uses calendar months and counts all training devices.
Fixed: Next licence follows the EASA rules more closely. PPL(A) has no night requirement, and ATPL(H) needs 350 h multi-pilot.
Improved: Simulator time now counts towards your licence where EASA allows it, up to the limits.
Improved: ATPL PIC now counts PICUS, and ATPL night counts only as PIC or co-pilot.
New: Replay your best week on the map, flight by flight.
Improved: Best week and Longest XC maps are cleaner, with airport codes in cyan.
Fixed: Flights on a Monday now count towards their own week.
New: Best week and Longest XC have a new look with your flights on the map. Tap the map to replay the week or the whole flight.
Improved: Projections and Next licence have calmer colours, a taller chart and smaller buttons.
New: Next licence has a new look. See how ready you are, which requirement sets the date and every licence you've completed, as a chart or a list.
Improved: Experience & projections is now simply called Projections.
New: Experience & projections has a new look. Drag your target on the chart, try another pace and follow your goals.
New: Custom CSV export for your drone logbook, and drone CSV import now works like the pilot import.
Fixed: Sharing an export no longer risks freezing the app.
Fixed: Scanning never accepts a time that doesn't exist, like 07:80, and suggests real times instead.
Fixed: The maps no longer stop responding after you open an airport's weather.
Fixed: The globe on the dashboard comes back by itself if it stops moving.
Improved: This message now only shows what's new since your last update.
